elements.title: Salient Statistics—United States
elements.content:
|                                   | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023e |
|-----------------------------------|------|------|------|------|-------|
| Production, marketable¹            | 510  | 460  | 480  | 430  | 400   |
| Sales by producers, marketable¹   | 480  | 500  | 490  | 400  | 470   |
| Imports for consumption            | 5,150| 5,370| 6,480| 4,940| 5,000 |
| Exports                          | 145  | 147  | 112  | 267  | 160   |
| Consumption, apparent¹, ²          | 5,500| 5,700| 6,900| 5,100| 5,300 |
| Price, average, f.o.b. mine, dollars per metric ton of K2O equivalent: |      |      |      |      |       |
|   All products³                | 820  | 850  | 1,120| 1,790| 1,210 |
|   MOP                         | 480  | 450  | 650  | 980  | 640   |
| Employment, mine and mill, number  | 900  | 900  | 900  | 900  | 900   |
| Net import reliance⁴ as a percentage of apparent consumption | 91   | 92   | 93   | 92   | 91    |
elements.notes:
¹ Marketable production is production sold or used by producers, excluding consumption of company material.
² Apparent consumption is production + imports - exports.
³ Average price for all products includes MOP and SOP.
⁴ Net import reliance = (Imports - Exports) / Apparent Consumption x 100.
